findings.what: The condition is inverted: `disarm_settings_candidate` returns true when it cancelled an armed candidate, so movement now runs only after a cancel (cancel and move together) and never runs when nothing is armed, which breaks all normal cursor movement. It needs `!self.disarm_settings_candidate()`.
